review.note: NPS describes the Buffalo as free-flowing. Individual landing records and imagery identify this segment; the line follows the visible river corridor. Low-water usability remains separate. Geometry, endpoint and mileage checks pass. This review does not enable GPS ETA, adopt new calculator distances, or establish current floatability.
